sqlMap.select: SELECT nvl(BUYER_ITEM_NO, ' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO FROM IF_PODT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND LEGACY_PO_NO = #LEGACY_PO_NO# AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = #LEGACY_PO_SEQ#

SELECT MAX(PROCESS_TYPE) AS PROCESS_TYPE FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#),' ') AND LEGACY_PO_NO = NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PO_NO#),' ') AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ= NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PO_SEQ#),' ') AND BUYER_ITEM_NO= NVL(TRIM(#BUYER_ITEM_NO#),' ') AND STATUS IN ('C','R')

SELECT #LEGACY_PO_NO#||'-'||NVL(B.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL,'X') AS LEGACY_INV_NO FROM ICOMPODT A, WMSIVDT B WHERE A.BUYER = NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#),' ') AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PO_NO#),' ') AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ=NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PO_SEQ#),' ') AND A.PROCESS_TYPE = '2' AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS != 'D'

SELECT #LEGACY_PO_NO#||'-'||NVL(C.LEGACY_IV_SERIAL,'X') AS LEGACY_INV_NO FROM ICOMPODT A, ICOMIVDT B, ICOMIVHD C WHERE A.BUYER = NVL(TRIM(#BUYER#),' ') AND A.LEGACY_PO_NO = NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PO_NO#),' ') AND A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ=NVL(TRIM(#LEGACY_PO_SEQ#),' ') AND A.PROCESS_TYPE != '2' AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = B.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = B.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS != 'D' AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.INV_NO = C.INV_NO AND C.STATUS != 'D'
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO IF_GRDT_UC ( KEP_SEQ, SITE, BUYER, STATUS, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ, BUYER_ITEM_NO, BUYER_ITEM_NO1, CURRENCY_CODE, UNIT_PRICE, GR_QTY, GR_AMT, GR_DATE, LEGACY_PR_NO, LEGACY_INV_NO, LEGACY_GR_NO, LEGACY_GR_SEQ, REVISION, RO_QTY, RO_AMT, REMARK, ERROR_MSG, REF_IF_NO, REF_IF_NO1, FILE_NAME, LOAD_DATE, LOAD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, IF_FLAG, BYIT_COMORG_CODE, PO_NO, PO_SEQ, TARGET_PRICE, DELY_TO_LOCATION, PLANT ) VALUES ( SEQ_IF_GRDT_UC.NEXTVAL, NVL(#SITE#,'KA'), #BUYER#, #STATUS#, #LEGACY_PO_NO#, #LEGACY_PO_SEQ#, #BUYER_ITEM_NO#, #BUYER_ITEM_NO1#, #CURRENCY_CODE#, #UNIT_PRICE#, #GR_QTY#, #GR_AMT#, #GR_DATE#, #LEGACY_PR_NO#, #LEGACY_INV_NO#, #LEGACY_GR_NO#, #LEGACY_GR_SEQ#, #REVISION#, #RO_QTY#, #RO_AMT#, #REMARK#, #ERROR_MSG#, #REF_IF_NO#, #REF_IF_NO1#, #FILE_NAME#, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #ADD_USER_ID#, #CHANGE_DATE#, #CHANGE_TIME#, #CHANGE_USER_ID#, 'N', #BYIT_COMORG_CODE#, #PO_NO#, #PO_SEQ#, #TARGET_PRICE#, #DELY_TO_LOCATION#, #PLANT# )
